objectives.description: Record baseline verify-deploy.sh failure set before deploying
Check for concurrent/foreign activity before deploying
Confirm all four deployed copies match source
Re-run verify-deploy.sh and compare against baseline
Record stall_suspected non-change statement in summary
Commit source-store edits with targeted staging

approaches_tried.approach: Initial baseline verify-deploy.sh launch attempts using a nested timeout wrapper without capturing the real PID directly in the same foreground call
approaches_tried.reason: The Bash tool's own 120s auto-background fired before the inner timeout could resolve, and two retries ended up writing to the same log file concurrently, corrupting progress tracking. Resolved by killing all duplicate chains and restarting with nohup+disown+pid-capture in a single foreground call, then polling that captured PID directly.

notes: Baseline verify-deploy.sh (pre-deploy): 3 of 36 failed -- gate 3 doc-lint, gate 5 manifest content-hash mismatch (scripts/tests/test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh), gate 8 run-all.sh. All three traceable to the concurrent sibling's then-uncommitted edits to verify-deploy.sh / test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh, matching the dispatch's advance warning.

Post-deploy full verify-deploy.sh: 1 of 36 failed -- gate 8 run-all.sh only. Gates 3 and 5 cleared between the two runs because the sibling landed its own commit in the interim. No new failure introduced by this task's 4 files.

Host was under heavy concurrent load from multiple sibling orchestrated dispatches each running their own verify-deploy.sh/run-all.sh instances in parallel, which is why both gate-set runs took far longer than the documented ~2.8min baseline (roughly 9-10 minutes each).
